selection: Six errors with lowest SHA256(event_id), inspected after development predictions; qualitative diagnosis only

examples.review_note: Narrative describes a landspout while the source reference is Thunderstorm Wind; label/text alignment may be ambiguous. Do not automatically treat the source as semantic certainty.
Narrative contains EF-0 and rotating mesocyclone evidence; adapter missed the Tornado reference despite this evidence.
Damage-only description lacks explicit hazard identity in the event narrative; context limitations remain.
Opposite-direction damage is described without explicitly naming the hazard; this is difficult text-only evidence.
Snow-squall and whiteout conditions coexist with strong wind measurements; multi-hazard ambiguity.
Both wind and hail are described and another hail entry is referenced; single-label assignment does not capture every mentioned hazard.
